L120: ## Frequently Asked Questions
L121: ### What is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
L122: 
L123: Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai is the first and only Trump-branded development in the Middle East, delivered by DarGlobal. It combines a five-star hotel, private residences, and a members-only club in a single address on Sheikh Zayed Road, with direct access to Downtown Dubai.
L124: ### What unit types and sizes are available at Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
L125: 
L126: The Trump Residences offer one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom duplex penthouses, ranging from 109 to 722 sqm. Every unit is positioned to deliver a guaranteed view of either the Arabian Sea or the Burj Khalifa.
L127: ### When will Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai be completed?
L128: 
L129: The project is under development with handover scheduled for December 2031. DarGlobal is the master developer. Buyers purchasing off-plan should contact the DarGlobal sales team directly for current payment plan terms and availability.
L130: ### Where exactly is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai located?
L131: 
L132: The tower sits on Sheikh Zayed Road at the gateway to Downtown Dubai, giving residents direct access to Dubai Mall, the Dubai Fountains, and the Burj Khalifa district while bypassing the congestion of central Downtown.
L133: ### Does Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai have the world's highest pool?
L134: 
L135: Yes. The development features the highest outdoor infinity pool in the world, reserved exclusively for residents of the Trump Residences. The rooftop pool overlooks the full Dubai skyline and is one of the project's defining headline amenities.
L136: ### What is the Trump Members-Only Club?
L137: 
L138: The Trump Members-Only Club is a private club within the tower, accessible by annual membership fee with residents receiving priority access. It includes a signature bar, cigar lounge, golf simulator, spa treatment rooms, meeting rooms, and a dedicated pool.
L139: ### What amenities are exclusive to residents of the Trump Residences?
L140: 
L141: Residents have exclusive access to the world's highest rooftop infinity pool, a state-of-the-art gym, an owners lounge, and a children's play area. Membership to the Trump Members-Only Club is available separately for access to the wider lifestyle facilities within the building.
L142: ### Is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai a good investment?
L143: 
L144: The project sits in one of Dubai's highest-demand corridors, combining a globally recognised brand, a world-record amenity, and direct Downtown proximity. Branded residences in Dubai have historically commanded rental premiums over comparable unbranded units; buyers should seek independent advice on investment suitability.
L145: ### How does Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai differ from other luxury towers in Dubai?
L146: 
L147: It is the only development in the Middle East to combine a Trump five-star hotel, a residents-only world-record infinity pool, and a private members club under one address. The hotel-residential structure gives owners access to hotel-grade services alongside private ownership.
L148: ### How do I register interest or enquire about buying at Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
L149: 
L150: Prospective buyers can register interest, download the project brochure, or book a private viewing through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can confirm current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan details on request.

L123: ### What is Tierra Viva?
L124: 
L125: Tierra Viva is a limited collection of ultra-luxury gated villas in Benahavís, Spain, developed by DarGlobal with design inspired by Automobili Lamborghini. Villas are staggered across the hillside at different levels in the Los Jaralillos district to ensure every home captures unobstructed panoramas of the Mediterranean Sea.
L126: ### What is Automobili Lamborghini's involvement in Tierra Viva?
L127: 
L128: Automobili Lamborghini provided the design inspiration for Tierra Viva, with the project integrating the brand's approach to cutting-edge design, technology, and artisanal craftsmanship into villa architecture and interiors. The collaboration between DarGlobal and Lamborghini positions Tierra Viva as a convergence of performance culture and ultra-luxury residential living.
L129: ### What villa sizes are available at Tierra Viva?

L132: ### When will Tierra Viva be completed?

L135: ### Where exactly is Tierra Viva located?
L136: 
L137: Tierra Viva is in the hills of Los Jaralillos, Benahavís, 15 minutes from Marbella and within easy reach of Puerto Banús and Sotogrande. L143: Spain's Golden Visa programme is available to non-EU buyers making qualifying real estate investments. That pairing targets a very specific international buyer pool, which supports both value retention and resale appetite.

L125: ### What is Marea, Interiors by Missoni?
L126: 
L127: Marea, Interiors by Missoni is an exclusive branded residential community within the Finca Cortesin gated estate on Costa Del Sol, Spain, developed by DarGlobal. Missoni provided the interior design across the collection of two-, three-, and four-bedroom residences, which overlook the Mediterranean Sea and an elite golf course set against a 270-degree panorama.
L128: ### What did Missoni design at Marea?
L129: 
L130: Missoni's design team was responsible for the interiors throughout the residences, bringing the Italian fashion house's signature approach to colour, pattern, and material quality into kitchens, bathrooms, and living spaces. The brand-led interiors give each residence a distinctive identity beyond standard luxury specification.
L131: ### What unit types and sizes are available at Marea?
L132: 
L133: Marea offers two-, three-, and four-bedroom residences ranging from 223 to 553 sqm. The community is a gated complex within the Finca Cortesin estate, with each unit designed for the panoramic sea and mountain views the site commands.
L134: ### When will Marea, Interiors by Missoni be completed?
L135: 
L136: Phase 1 of Marea completed in 2024. The full development is scheduled for completion in December 2027. The project is under development by DarGlobal. Contact the sales team for current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan terms.
L137: ### Where is Marea, Interiors by Missoni located?
L138: 
L139: Marea sits within the Finca Cortesin gated estate in Cortesin, Costa Del Sol. The beach is 5 minutes away, Marbella is 20 minutes, Puerto Banús and Sotogrande are a 20-minute drive, Santa Maria Polo Club is 15 minutes, Gibraltar Airport is 45 minutes, and Malaga Airport is 50 minutes.
L140: ### What is the 270-degree view at Marea?
L141: 
L142: The site's elevation and orientation give residences an unobstructed 270-degree panorama that stretches from Marbella along the Costa Del Sol coastline, across to Gibraltar, and continues to the mountains of Morocco on the African continent, with the Mediterranean Sea and Finca Cortesin golf course directly below.
L143: ### What amenities does Marea, Interiors by Missoni offer?
L144: 
L145: Amenities include a gated community with private entrance and 24/7 premium security, 24-hour concierge, infinity pool, state-of-the-art gym, tennis courts, hanging observation deck, community garden, children's playground, children's swimming pool, children's splash area, and dedicated parking and storage per unit.
L146: ### What is the Finca Cortesin estate?
L147: 
L148: Finca Cortesin is one of Costa Del Sol's most prestigious private estates, home to the five-star Finca Cortesin Hotel and Golf Club. Marea's location within this estate gives residents access to the exclusivity and security of one of Spain's most recognised luxury addresses on the Costa del Sol.
L149: ### Why invest in Costa Del Sol property near Cortesin?
L150: 
L151: Costa Del Sol combines Spain's highest real estate ROI in Europe with Eurozone interest rates between 3 and 5%, a Mediterranean climate year-round, and strong tourism that supports rental demand. Cortesin's proximity to Marbella, Sotogrande, and Gibraltar positions it within a corridor that draws international buyers and second-home investors consistently.

L154:

L168: ## Frequently Asked Questions
L169: ### What is Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
L170: 
L171: Marriott Residences Aida, Oman is a fully furnished branded apartment complex at AIDA, Muscat. The project is developed by Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC, which uses the Marriott name under license from Marriott International. Residences come with à la carte hotel-style services and are designed to deliver the comfort and standard associated with the Marriott brand.
L172: ### Who developed Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
L173: 
L174: The project is developed by Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC, which operates the Marriott brand name under a licensing agreement with Marriott International, Inc. Marriott Residences Aida, Oman are not owned, developed, or sold by Marriott International or its affiliates.
L175: ### What unit types and sizes are available?
L176: 
L177: The development offers one-, two-, and three-bedroom fully furnished apartments ranging from 60 to 194 sqm. Each residence is designed with contemporary decor and thoughtfully furnished to offer stylish, comfortable living with seamless integration across all spaces.
L178: ### What services do residents receive at Marriott Residences?
L179: 
L180: Residents benefit from à la carte services styled around the Marriott standard, including a dedicated concierge, 24-hour reception desk, doorman, lobby, and valet. The service model is designed to bring hotel-quality living to private residential ownership at the AIDA estate.
L181: ### What amenities does AIDA offer for Marriott Residences owners?
L182: 
L183: The AIDA estate provides a championship golf course, swimming pools, a private beach enclave, children's splash areas, wellness centres, fitness centre, plazas, cafes and restaurants, hiking trails, mountain bike trails, running trail, promenades, viewing decks, parks, a clubhouse, outdoor landscapes, and access to nearby 5-star hotels including Nikki Beach, Al Bustan Palace Ritz-Carlton, Shangri-La, and Jumeirah Muscat Bay.
L184: ### When will Marriott Residences Aida, Oman be completed?
L185: 
L186: Completion is expected in September 2029. The development is currently under construction. Contact DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk to register interest, book a unit, or download the project brochure.
L187: ### Can foreign nationals buy property at Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
L188: 
L189: Yes. Oman offers 100% freehold ownership for all nationalities on qualifying Integrated Tourism Complex (ITC) properties. Buyers on ITC-registered projects are eligible for a lifetime residency visa. An exclusive mortgage program is also available in Oman for both resident and non-resident buyers.
L190: ### What are the tax advantages of investing in Oman?
L191: 
L192: Oman applies 0% personal income tax, 0% capital gains tax, and 0% inheritance tax, with inheritance assessed under the investor's own country's laws rather than local law. Businesses in special economic and free zones benefit from a 25-year exemption from corporate income taxes.
L193: ### Why invest in Muscat real estate now?
L194: 
L195: Oman ranked 7th globally and 1st in Asia and the Arab world in the Numbeo Quality of Life Index in 2023, and is one of the safest countries worldwide. The country targets over $22.5 billion per year from tourism by 2040. The Saudi-Oman Highway cuts travel time by 16 hours between the two countries, and an upcoming railway project connecting the UAE to Muscat will further strengthen regional connectivity and investment appeal.
L196: ### How does Marriott Residences relate to the wider AIDA development?
L197: 
L198: Marriott Residences is one of several residential products within the AIDA estate in Muscat. Other DarGlobal projects at AIDA include Trump International Hotel Oman, Trump Golf Villas, The Great Escape 2, and Sunrise Haven. Together they form a multi-branded, fully integrated resort community 130 metres above the Muscat Riviera.

L130: ## Frequently Asked Questions
L131: ### What are Trump Cliff Villas at AIDA?
L132: 
L133: Trump Cliff Villas are a collection of fully furnished three-bedroom sea-view villas at AIDA, Muscat, developed by DarGlobal. Each villa is positioned directly beside the Trump International Hotel at 130 metres above the Muscat Riviera, with a private pool overlooking the sea. Villas are designed and furnished to the highest standard, with every detail specified down to specification.
L134: ### What are the villa sizes and unit types available?
L135: 
L136: Trump Cliff Villas offer three-bedroom furnished residences from 128 to 166 sqm. Each villa includes a private pool with sea views. Owners receive a Trump International Golf Club Social Membership as part of the purchase and have the option to reside in or lease the villa.
L137: ### What does the Trump Cliff Villas offer that other AIDA products do not?
L138: Trump Cliff Villas offer full villa ownership with a private pool, the closest positioning to the Trump International Hotel, and the most elevated sea views on the AIDA estate. Unlike Trump Golf Villas, which face the golf course, These villas are positioned on the cliff edge with direct sea orientation. Both villa products sit within the same AIDA estate and share access to the same championship golf course and community facilities.
L139: ### What amenities are available to Trump Cliff Villa owners?
L140: Within the AIDA estate, villa owners have access to the Trump International Golf Club Oman (18-hole championship course), Trump Members Only Club, The SHFT Night Club, 5-star dining and culinary facilities, AIDA Beach, Trump Hotels Hanging Suites, a Trump International Hotel lobby, community and retail centres, plazas, cafes and restaurants, wellness centres, fitness centre, promenades, hiking trails, mountain bike trails, running trail, viewing decks, and outdoor landscapes across the cliffside estate.
L141: ### When will Trump Cliff Villas be completed?
L142: 
L143: Completion is scheduled for December 2028. Construction is underway and live progress feeds are available on the DarGlobal project page. Contact DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk to book a unit, choose your residence via the online navigator, or download the project brochure.
L144: ### Can I lease my Trump Cliff Villa when I am not using it?
L145: 
L146: Yes. The entry data states that owners have the choice to reside in or lease their villa. The Trump management association with the property supports the leasing proposition. Contact DarGlobal for further details on the leasing model and revenue arrangements.
L147: ### Can foreign nationals buy Trump Cliff Villas in Oman?
L148: 
L149: Yes. Oman offers 100% freehold ownership for all nationalities on qualifying Integrated Tourism Complex (ITC) properties. ITC project buyers are eligible for a lifetime residency visa in Oman. An exclusive mortgage program is available in Oman for both resident and non-resident buyers. Buyers should confirm specific eligibility conditions with DarGlobal or their legal advisor.
L150: ### What are the tax advantages of investing in Oman real estate?
L151: 
L152: Oman applies 0% personal income tax, 0% capital gains tax, and 0% inheritance tax, with inheritance assessed under the investor's own country's laws. Businesses in special economic and free zones benefit from a 25-year exemption from corporate income taxes.
L153: ### Why invest in Muscat property now?
L154: 
L155: Oman ranked 7th globally and 1st in both Asia and the Arab world in the Numbeo Quality of Life Index in 2023, and is one of the safest countries in the world. Tourism earnings are projected to exceed $22.5 billion per year by 2040. The Saudi-Oman Highway cuts travel time between the two countries by 16 hours, and an upcoming UAE-Muscat railway project will further strengthen connectivity and investment activity.
L156: ### How do Trump Cliff Villas relate to the wider AIDA development?
L157: 
L158: Trump Cliff Villas are one of several residential products within the AIDA estate in Muscat. Other DarGlobal products at AIDA include Trump International Hotel Oman (hotel room ownership), Trump Golf Villas (five-bedroom fairway villas), Marriott Residences Aida, The Great Escape 2, and Sunrise Haven. Together they form a fully integrated branded resort community 130 metres above the Muscat Riviera.

L13: 30/09/2026

L15: Dar Global, the London-listed luxury international real estate developer, recently announced its unaudited interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (HY 2026), reporting a 66% revenue increase to US$258.0 million (HY 2025: US$155.4 million). The performance was driven by the Group’s projects and sustained demand across its diversified portfolio in the GCC, Europe, and the UK.
L16: Gross profit for the period rose 85% to US$87.7 million, expanding margins to 34% (from 31%). EBITDA increased 73% to US$46.3 million, while net profit surged 149% to US$30.4 million (HY 2025: US$12.2 million). Dar Global maintained a robust balance sheet with a Net Asset Value of US$613.3 million and total cash balances of US$847.9 million (comprising US$231.6 million free cash and US$616.3 million restricted escrow), supporting total available liquidity of US$579.3 million.
L18: Operational momentum accelerated in Saudi Arabia with major project launches. In January, the Group partnered with The Trump Organization to launch Rayana, a 2.6 million sq. m gated community in Diriyah featuring luxury mansions and a championship golf course, followed by a SAR 338 million (~US$90 million) infrastructure contract award to Compass and Bin Omairah Company.

L18: DarGlobal, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, is marking its fifth anniversary following a period of rapid international expansion that has transformed the company into a USD 23 billion global real estate platform serving investors from more than 125 nationalities.
L19: Since launching its first project in Dubai in 2021, DarGlobal has expanded across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Oman, Qatar, Spain, Greece and the United Kingdom, establishing a diversified portfolio of luxury residential, hospitality and lifestyle destinations.

L22: Ziad El Chaar, Chief Executive Officer of DarGlobal, said: "Over the last five years, we have built a company designed for global citizens, investors who increasingly live, work and invest across multiple countries. What began as a luxury real estate developer has evolved into a diversified platform spanning real estate, hospitality, golf, private clubs, asset management and emerging real estate technologies, developed alongside some of the world's most recognised brands.
L23: As we look ahead, our ambition is not simply to build homes, but to create destinations, experiences and ecosystems that define the future of luxury living."
L24: As part of its next phase of growth, DarGlobal has expanded into hospitality and entertainment, with luxury hotels under development in Dubai, Riyadh and Muscat. The company is also building a portfolio of golf destinations and private members' clubs across key international markets.

L28: "We believe we are only at the beginning of our growth journey," El Chaar added. "Our ambition is to continue building one of the world's leading real estate platforms for global citizens while creating long-term value for our investors, partners and customers."

L337: ## Explore Properties for Sale in Saudi Arabia
L338: Saudi Arabia is the most sought-after country in the Middle East. Obviously, it is anything but a boring place to live. KSA has a vast cultural and religious background that people have been visiting worldwide for centuries. Moreover, with the 2030 vision, Saudi Arabia has become the modern-day Dubai, with skyscrapers and modern architectural designs.
L339: Each city in Saudi holds a different cultural and commercial value, and depending on what kind of thing piques your interest, you get to choose where you want to reside, from 【39†Properties for Sale in Saudi Arabia†wasalt.com】 or 【40†Properties for Rent in Saudi Arabia†wasalt.com】. Even to the uneducated eye, Saudi Arabia is not just a desert country with tall palm trees and bedouin men.
L340: As a matter of fact, the Kingdom holds the holiest place on Earth for Muslims, the grand mosque of Mecca, which secures the holy Kaaba. By word of God, this land is secured and nourished with unending blessings and riches. One of its most famous cities, Jeddah, overlooks the stunning Red Sea with a broad breathtaking corniche. Those who have visited Saudi Arabia once felt more than welcomed on their own by the generosity of its people.
L341: Hence, they are keen to see it again and again, browsing through 【41†Apartments for Rent in Saudi Arabia†wasalt.com】. There are various cities worth exploring in Saudi Arabia, but hardly ever completed in one travel; the land has so much in store. The hospitality isn’t just limited to Muslims; except for Makkah, tourists from all over the world are invited to witness the cultural beauty and diversity of the beautiful Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
L342: ## Top Cities to Visit in Saudi Arabia
L343: ### 1. Riyadh...Beyond Imagination
L344: Starting off strong with the Kingdom’s capital, Riyadh, is the largest business hub in Saudi Arabia. It is where all the actual stuff goes down. So if you’re looking for a place to run a business, work at a successful company, or give your children a high-quality education, 【42†Apartments for Sale in Riyadh†wasalt.com】 is where you should look! Riyadh is one of the wealthiest cities in the Middle East. This statement is both true from a cultural perspective and a materialistic one.
L345: The city holds essential landmarks and historical sights, including the great Faisaliah Tower and The National Museum of Saudi Arabia. Most people travel to Riyadh to start their future there, as the job opportunities are anything but limited. So if you’re a hardworking young man with big city dreams, then Riyadh is where you should land. Also, if you’re a family man looking for a secure, luxurious place to settle down and live comfortably, you should look at 【43†Villas for Sale in Riyadh†wasalt.com】.
L346: ### 2. Jeddah Ghair
L347: The famous slogan of Jeddah, “Jeddah Ghair”, is translated to “Jeddah is Different”, and indeed it is. Jeddah is the most light-hearted city in Saudi Arabia, where people come so they can participate in various events, including car racing and music concerts. Jeddah is made for those who want to be surrounded by natural scenery and crystal clear waterfronts. To live by the sea and enjoy blissful weather all year, you should start looking for 【44†Apartments for Sale in Jeddah†wasalt.com】.
L348: Jeddah is also home to many international restaurants and cafes, with nicely built malls and commercial centres. For many people, Jeddah is considered a gateway to Makkah, a city worth passing by when performing the annual Hajj or pilgrimage. In a more religious sense, Jeddah is also home to beautifully built mosques and places of worship. A prime example of these mosques is Al Rahma Mosque, where you’d just be struck with awe when you visit it.
L349: There are also several other landmarks, including Al Shallal Theme Park, which is loved mainly by children. There is also the breathtaking Saif Beach overlooking the beautiful Red Sea. Hurry up now and lead the life of your dreams by buying your next home from 【45†Properties for Sale in Jeddah†wasalt.com】.
L350: ### 3. Dammam…The Famous Commercial Hub of KSA
L351: Dammam is a great city, from its picturesque corniche over the Persian Gulf to its contemporary architectural buildings. It is truly a city out of this world. Dammam is one of the Kingdom’s largest cities and has many wonders. Everyone living in Dammam has a great story to tell about where they visited the corniche or its historical sights. Moreover, Dammam has a collection of beautiful islands worth visiting.
L352: So next time you’re in Dammam, make sure to bring your camera! Dammam is very famous for at the heart of the oil industry of Saudi Arabia, which makes it one of the wealthiest cities in the Kingdom, with endless job opportunities. To add the cherry on top, Dammam enjoys a wide range of luxurious neighbourhoods with top-notch 【46†Apartments for Sale in Dammam†wasalt.com】. Whether you are a tourist, native or ex-pat, Dammam is the ideal place.
L353: Book your luxury stay in Dammam by browsing through 【47†Properties for Sale in Dammam†wasalt.com】.
L354: ### 4. Al Madinah Al Munawwarah…Home to Al Masjid Al Nabawy
L355: The second holiest city in Saudi Arabia after Makkah is “Al Madinah Al Munawwarah”, which translates to “The Illuminated City”. Madinah is famous for being the city that welcomed Prophet Muhammad, Peace Be Upon Him during the struggles of delivering his message, and it came to be the city where his grave is located. Muslims worldwide visit Madinah to witness Al Masjid Al Nabawy, i.e., Prophet’s Mosque, and see the Prophet’s grave.
L356: It’s a peaceful heart-warming city that will leave you overwhelmed with emotions.
